scope: Curated representatives selected by visual subtype from the 216-image local inventory. Color-only, dataset-only, repeated batch and historical variants are omitted; original local artifacts remain preserved.
exclusions: Third-party reference images and scraped source galleries
Source/output comparison sheets, contact sheets and browser captures
Technical receipt-test image and first-render debugging drafts
Superseded outputs in malformed --file=workspace directory outside workspace
